summary.text: Amy Paschal is a Democratic member of the Colorado House of Representatives from District 18 who took office on January 8, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A software engineer by career, she is running against Republican Adriana Cuva.

paragraphs.text: Amy Paschal was born in Rochester, Minnesota, and earned a high school diploma from Highland Park Senior High School.

She earned a bachelor's degree from Macalester College in 1986 and a graduate degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 1988, and her career experience includes working as a software engineer.
Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as the League of Women Voters, American Association of University Women, El Paso County Democratic Party and Sierra Club.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Paschal said she lives in Colorado Springs, has 18 years of experience in the software industry as a software engineer, data analyst and project manager, and spent 15 years as a stay-at-home mother.

She said she volunteered for the Democratic Party for eight years before her first election to the legislature, held leadership positions in the El Paso County and Colorado Democratic parties, and served as an elections judge.
Paschal defeated James Boelens in the November 5, 2024 general election and was unopposed in the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Energy and Environment Committee, the Transportation, Housing, and Local Government Committee and the Technology Committee.

In the same survey, Paschal described her campaign messages as practical solutions over culture wars, long-term solutions over short-term fixes, and trust in the state's election system and independent redistricting process.
She said that two-thirds of her bills in her first term were bipartisan and that she supports a graduated income tax as part of a long-term budget solution.
She listed affordability and responsible growth, including regulation of data centers, among the policy areas she is passionate about.
